test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a triangle MNO, XA, XB and XC are perpendicular bisectors on sides MN, ON and OM respectively intersect each other at X. If ∠NMO = 55 degree, then what is the value of ∠NXO?
solution:
**Given:**

In a triangle MNO, XA, XB and XC are perpendicular bisectors on sides MN, ON and OM

respectively intersect each other at X.

∠NMO = 55° 

**Concept Used:**

If O is the circumcenter of the △ABC then the angle made at the circumcenter by joining any

two vertices of the triangle is twice the angle at the third vertex of the triangle i.e. the angle

made at the circumference at the circle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6445f0b2ebde4b8a10b55a05562ef6e2eefb898d7d07443b3598a197f3724d5.png] 

∠NXO is the angle made at the circumcenter of the triangle.

So,

∠NXO = 2 × ∠NMO

∠NXO = 2 × 55°

∠NXO = 110° 

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** Don't assume that CX will pass through vertex N 

As a perpendicular bisector does not assert that.

hence we can not say ∠ AXC has a vertically opposite angle (i.e. ∠ NXO)
